item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】WAV - MARINA - The Family Jewels (2nd Album Sampler) [16bit/44.1kHz]
item.description:
The most rare and requested MARINA sampler, with alternative versions of all tracks.

01. I'm Not A Robot
Original single version of the song.

02. Girls (Alternative Mix)
Mastered and HQ WAV Mix of ''Fast Car Mix''.

03. Shampain (Demo 2)
Also known as ''The Shampin Sleeper''. The version from 1st sampler is currently diffrent from that one.

04. Obsessions
Video/Single Mix with alternative production.

05. Mowgli's Road (falselly labelled as ''unedited'')
Fully mastered demo, first released on ''Obsessions - Single'' but in low quality. We have the full mix in HQ right now.
